scope: Three alternative image references with texture-free tops; generated meshes not tested

assets.title: 案1：白磁と濃紺の薄縁
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone 3D asset reference image for LORE's duel platform in Biblion magic library, for image-to-3D reconstruction.
The attached image is ONLY a reference for the platform's broad rounded oblong silhouette, low proportions, and elevated camera. DO NOT preserve its marble texture, veins, cracked appearance, wear, surface variations, segmented top, or rivets.
CRITICAL FUNCTIONAL CONSTRAINT: The entire playable TOP is one perfectly planar, homogeneous, featureless solid surface. No marble veining, no cracks, no speckles, no grain, no brush strokes, no fine texture, no fabric fibers, no runes, no engraving, no embossing, no relief, no seams, no tiles, no central emblem, no rings on the top, no bumps, no dents, no recesses, no raised lip above the playing plane. Absolutely no decorative element projects onto or above the top. Its visible colour is uniform edge-to-edge, matte satin with very high roughness, almost no specular highlight, no reflections. The top should resemble a pristine CAD planar face in a sophisticated material, not a textured illustration. Soft lighting must not create mottled patterns or spotlights on it. It is essential to prevent an image-to-3D model from interpreting surface texture as geometry.
Keep the same broad rounded oblong/stadium-like footprint from the reference, long horizontal axis, shallow slab, large uncluttered playing area occupying at least 95 percent of the upper face. Put all craft and decoration exclusively on the narrow OUTWARD-FACING VERTICAL sides below the level of the top.
Composition: isolated single complete object with 8 percent margins, landscape, elevated three-quarter camera close to the reference, about 60 degrees above horizontal, long axis horizontal, all edges visible, slight side thickness visible at front. Plain neutral light gray seamless studio background, even soft neutral ambient light, subtle contact shadow only below the object. Premium game environment hard-surface asset, clean physically coherent surfaces. No room, bookshelves, pillars, crystals, cards, people, UI, text, logos, labels, dimension arrows or multi-view collage.
Design option 1, IVORY THIN RIM: Keep the calm elegant character of the current white platform while removing all texture. The entire top is uniform warm-white fine porcelain, absolutely smooth and planar, blank and matte. Very slim midnight navy solid side apron with a single fine continuous champagne-gold hairline at the OUTSIDE vertical top edge; no separate raised rail. A second hairline near the bottom of the side outlines its slim profile. Minimal monolithic construction, quietly luxurious, almost floating on a tiny hidden inset foot. No columns, no brackets, no corner ornaments. The refinement comes from perfect proportions, a very thin bevel and the ivory/navy/gold contrast. Total visible thickness is about 3 percent of overall platform depth.

A smooth thick ivory-white architectural side apron below the plane has a restrained rhythm of FIVE broad shallow pointed-arch recessed panels around the visible FRONT VERTICAL SIDE, reminiscent of the Biblion library's white architecture. These arches are large simple solid geometry cut ONLY into the outside vertical side, never into the top. No holes going through to the top, no tiny latticework, no miniature columns, no dark noisy detail. Each arch recess is smooth slightly darker ivory. This is a graceful architectural slab with softly sculpted white sides and fine gold, not a gothic ruin or ornate jewelry. Thickness about 6 percent of platform depth, broad and low, no legs.
